text: PlanSmart is a digital application developed by the Government of the Philippines in collaboration with the World Bank's GFDRR. It automates and standardizes recovery and reconstruction plans post-disaster, utilizing national multi-hazard risk data. The platform, launched in 2022, includes the 'PlanSmart Ready to Rebuild' module and has been scaled to over a hundred local governments. It integrates with pre-arranged disaster financing instruments and sector-specific versions, such as housing and education, to enhance recovery planning efficiency.
